entities.summary: Jochen Reimer is a German former professional ice hockey goaltender who played in the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL). He previously played with the Thomas Sabo Ice Tigers after a second tenure with EHC München from Grizzly Adams Wolfsburg on April 20, 2011.
